observations.limitations: All supplied hunks are complete and cover the Shopify OAuth token retrieval and error handling. No missing context or truncation.

observations.behavior: Adds a new error message constant and its use in the OAuth token retrieval and retry classification.
observations.posthog_connection: Allows PostHog to distinguish Shopify OAuth failures where the app and store are not in the same Shopify organization, preventing unnecessary credential re-entry and surfacing the correct fix.

observations.behavior: Adds a check for the shop_not_permitted error code in the OAuth error response parsing.
observations.posthog_connection: Maps the Shopify API response error code to the PostHog-specific error message, enabling the system to recognize and report this specific failure mode.

observations.behavior: Adds an Accept: application/json header to the OAuth token request and its use in the retry classification.
observations.posthog_connection: Forces Shopify to return JSON-formatted OAuth error responses instead of HTML, allowing PostHog to parse the error code and provide a specific message rather than a generic failure.
